decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Design & Access Statement, 163/01,163/02 Received: 21 August 2014 163/03B, 163/12B Received: 20 October 2014) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The building hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as [34 Addison Grove, Chiswick W4 1ER].

Condition : 5 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a single storey extension and alterations to the roof of the existing garage and conversion to an artist's studio ancillary to the main house
